description: One person from the audience, with their counts, tags, notes and mute for your organization, their outreach (owner, stage, last contacted), plus their public profile (bio, company, location, website and linked accounts) where the platform lists it. GitHub authors are looked up today; profile is null until then. Email addresses are not returned over MCP: profile.email is always null (the dashboard and the REST API show it where the person published it).
